s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of purpuric lesions with systemic involvement and multi-organ dysfunction
salient_findings: Purpuric lesions on face, elbows, knees, and feet
Skin sloughing off lesions on elbows and knees
Reticulated purpuric macules and patches on extensor surfaces
Dusky purpuric macules and patches on nose, cheeks, forehead, and ear
key_facts: Rouleaux and cryoprotein precipitate on peripheral blood smear
Abnormal paraprotein band on serum and urine protein electrophoreses
Monoclonal IgG-κ protein on immunofixation electrophoresis
Lytic bony lesions on CT scan of pelvis
Hypercellular marrow with 80% plasma cells and κ-light-chain restriction

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of purpuric lesions with systemic involvement and multi-organ dysfunction
salient_findings: Purpuric lesions on face, elbows, knees, and feet
Skin sloughing off lesions on elbows and knees
Reticulated purpuric macules and patches on extensor surfaces
Dusky purpuric macules and patches on nose, cheeks, forehead, and ear
key_facts: Rouleaux and cryoprotein precipitate on peripheral blood smear
Abnormal paraprotein band on serum and urine protein electrophoreses
Monoclonal IgG-κ protein on immunofixation electrophoresis
Lytic bony lesions on CT scan of pelvis
Hypercellular marrow with 80% plasma cells and κ-light-chain restriction

shortlist.label: Multiple myeloma
shortlist.why_kept: Hypercalcemia, lytic bony lesions, and hypercellular marrow with 80% plasma cells

shortlist.label: Cryoglobulinemia
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated serum cryoglobulin levels and cryoprotein precipitate on peripheral blood smear

shortlist.label: Mixed cryoglobulinemia
shortlist.why_kept: Purpuric lesions and presence of cryoglobulins and fibrin thrombi on biopsy

shortlist.label: Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia
shortlist.why_kept: Monoclonal IgG-κ protein and abnormal paraprotein band on serum and urine protein electrophoreses

shortlist.label: Monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of monoclonal IgG-κ protein and abnormal paraprotein band

raw.rationale: The presence of hypercalcemia, lytic bony lesions, and a hypercellular bone marrow with 80% plasma cells and κ-light-chain restriction are key findings that strongly support the diagnosis of multiple myeloma.

rejected.label: Cryoglobulinemia
rejected.why: While cryoglobulinemia is present, it is not the primary diagnosis, as the patient's bone marrow and other findings are more consistent with multiple myeloma.

rejected.label: Mixed cryoglobulinemia
rejected.why: Mixed cryoglobulinemia is a type of cryoglobulinemia, but the patient's overall clinical picture is more consistent with multiple myeloma.

rejected.label: Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia
rejected.why: Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia typically involves IgM monoclonal protein, whereas this patient has IgG-κ protein.

rejected.label: Monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance
rejected.why: The patient's extensive bone marrow involvement and presence of end-organ damage (e.g., lytic lesions, hypercalcemia) indicate a more advanced disease process than monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance.
